rules.alternatives: No hours are counted, but nurses must stay competent in their area of practice (e.g. refresher course, employer orientation, professional development) – the board leaves the method to the nurse.
rules.notes: The board repealed CE hours for renewal in late 2023 and no longer audits CE. RN and LPN licenses expire December 31 every two years (the FAQ cites a 12/31/2023 expiry). The board offers free contact-hour modules.
